easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Flamecache Gecko with haste.
When Flamecache Gecko enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Flamecache Gecko token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Flamecache Gecko token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.
